notes.0-4: Both senses live in the same sports context: 'the pitch was perfect' / 'the umpire watched the pitch' in a cricket or baseball scene can be read as the throw or as the playing field, and context need not separate them.
notes.2-4: A pitch (field or site) on a hillside: 'the pitch fell away steeply toward the river' can be read as the slope falling away or the field falling away.
